resources.string: Connect to your trusted AI Project Studio host over HTTPS. Sign in with your access key on the host page; this app does not save access keys.
Full terminal access has the host user’s permissions. Approve actions carefully. Only connect to a host you trust.
Your host address may be saved. To end a secure session, use Sign out in the host UI; changing hosts does not sign you out.
Could not connect securely. Check your host, connection and trusted HTTPS certificate, then retry. Certificate errors are never bypassed.
No browser is available to open this link.
This link is blocked. Only your configured HTTPS host can open inside the app.
Enter a valid HTTPS origin, for example https://studio.example.com.
HTTPS is required; HTTP is not secure.
Do not include a username, password or access key.
Use only the host origin: no path, query or fragment (a root / is allowed).
